answer: An agent marketplace for wharf bookings, shale shipments and jade appraisals requires every seller identity to lock a $500 bond for 30 days before bidding. Each identity gets one bid slot per auction, and verifiable delivery fraud forfeits its bond. An attacker seeking 1,000 slots must immobilize $500,000, pay the financing cost and risk losing bonds on fraudulent trades; generating extra names alone buys no access.
